europe_now.title: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers, mayor says
europe_now.summary: Berlin's mayor has stated that the city is currently under a cyber blackmail attack, with hackers threatening to release sensitive data unless demands are met. Authorities are investigating the incident as a significant security threat to municipal operations.

sources.headline: Berlin is being blackmailed by hackers, mayor says

europe_now.title: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues
europe_now.summary: Clashes erupted in the Spanish enclave of Ceuta between protesters and police amid ongoing tensions over migration. The Spanish government has urged calm while security forces manage the unrest.

sources.headline: Violence breaks out in Ceuta as migrant crisis continues

top_stories.title: Norway begins royal transition following King Harald V's death
top_stories.summary: King Harald V of Norway has died, prompting the ascension of Crown Prince Haakon to the throne. The royal family and nation are observing a period of mourning as the transition takes place.

sources.headline: Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon VIII ascends throne
Norway mourns King Harald as Haakon prepares to take the throne

top_stories.title: EU pushes Meta to extend US teen safety rules to European platforms
top_stories.summary: European Union officials are pressuring Meta to apply U.S. teen safety regulations to its services operating in Europe. The move reflects growing concerns over digital platform accountability for young users.
